He enters a full pitching motion, lifting his leg and driving forward. His focus is intense. (8) Low-angle shot of a player (Lin Tzu-wei) laughing and gesturing after a play. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the vibrant green of the grass and the stadium architecture.
